rationale: Revised plan addresses both self-identified findings. changes_summary: Added pharmacy_claims.prescriber_npi->providers.provider_npi to join_check pairs, completing the coverage of all provider-related relationships. The manifest indicates this relationship also fails completely (0% match rate, 18,310 unmatched records). This revision ensures the pharmacy provider linkage gap—which affects 100% of pharmacy claims—is fully documented and prominently cited in the report, addressing both the omitted relationship test and the need for better visibility into this critical data quality issue.
